case_number: 2025 INSC 395; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (@ S.L.P.(C) No(s). 827 OF 2017)

parties.respondent: M/S. N. SELVARAJALOU CHETTY TRUST REP. BY ITS TRUSTEES AND OTHERS

summary: Title dispute over 0.75 cents; court auction sale 1962 vested title in Padmini Chandrasekaran before Somasundaram's 1962 will; probated 1975 will bequeathed property to trust; sale deeds 1992 by adopted son invalid; possession follows title; adverse possession claim rejected; decree moulded for executor to implement will terms for Vinayagamurthy's benefit; HC confirmation upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment confirming decree in favor of trust upheld.
